rfp_text:
REQUEST FOR PROPOSAL — Citywide Network Refresh

Section 1.4: Award will be made on March 1, with project kickoff required on February 15. Section 5.2: Bidders must demonstrate annual revenue of at least $50,000,000 in each of the past three years. Section 9.3: Network cabling installation may be subcontracted to certified low-voltage installers.

risks.exact_quote: Award will be made on March 1, with project kickoff required on February 15
risks.issue_description: Project kickoff date precedes the award date by two weeks
risks.reasoning: Kickoff is scheduled before contract award is even made. No vendor can begin work without an executed contract, so the schedule as written is impossible to meet and reflects a drafting error.
risks.impact_if_unresolved: Vendors cannot reliably plan staffing and may price in schedule risk; risk of dispute at kickoff
risks.suggested_fix: Move kickoff to a date after award (e.g., March 8) or move award earlier

barriers.exact_quote: Bidders must demonstrate annual revenue of at least $50,000,000

requirement_analysis.what_is_required: $50M+ annual revenue for each of the last three years
requirement_analysis.industry_standard: $5M - $15M typical for similar regional network refresh contracts
requirement_analysis.justification_reasoning: Revenue floor excludes virtually all small businesses without scope-based justification

barriers.impact: Effectively a sole-source restriction in disguise
barriers.suggestion: Replace revenue floor with bonding capacity or equivalent risk metric scaled to contract value

questions.predicted_question: Is the kickoff date a typo, and what is the actual expected start date relative to award?

triggered_by.exact_quote: Award will be made on March 1, with project kickoff required on February 15

confusion_analysis.why_confusing: Kickoff precedes award, which is logically impossible — vendors cannot determine which date is wrong or what the corrected schedule should be.
possible_interpretations: Award date is a typo and should be earlier
Kickoff date is a typo and should be later
confusion_analysis.vendor_cannot_determine: Whether to staff up immediately upon award or operate on the original kickoff date

questions.urgency_justification: Schedule clarity is foundational to staffing and pricing the proposal
questions.impact_if_unresolved: Vendors will price defensive risk margins or simply no-bid
questions.suggested_fix: Issue an amendment correcting whichever date is in error

opportunities.rfp_text: Network cabling installation may be subcontracted to certified low-voltage installers
opportunities.naics_description: Electrical Contractors and Other Wiring Installation Contractors
opportunities.reasoning: Network cabling is a discrete trade scope routinely separated out from network engineering and is explicitly invited for subcontracting in this RFP.
